issue.title: Open the ACE agent detail document in the pager, exercising the dormant window-scoped labeller
issue.description:
Proposed by epic land agent sase-uk.land after landing epic sase-uk (A link-traversing
SASE pager). The epic's plan names this explicitly under "Out of scope for v1": "The
agent detail document itself stays out of the pager. It is the largest single UX win
available ... but it changes a keypath the owner uses constantly and deserves its own
proposal and its own goldens. Record it as a follow-up; do not ride it on this epic."
Not a defect and not caused by that epic.

Today the ACE Agents-tab detail pane renders 924-1,154 hints per render through
`AgentHintRender` (`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/`), and `v` on a selection
opens the *selected files* in `SasePager` — never the detail document itself. Opening
that document in the pager is what would make every ref, path, and URL inside an agent's
own record pressable, which is the epic's whole thesis applied to the densest document
in the tree.

sase-uk shipped the mechanism that makes it possible. `src/sase/pager/_labels.py`
carries a window-scoped label mode (`LabelWindowScope`,
`PAGER_LABEL_TWO_KEY_CAPACITY`), shipped dormant: past two-key capacity the pager labels
only the visible band plus one screen of overscan and re-anchors when the viewport
leaves it. `src/sase/pager/app.py` already selects it
(`_current_label_window_scope`, `_refresh_window_scoped_labels_if_needed`). Nothing in
the tree exercises that path with a real document, because no shipped document exceeds
the two-key budget.

Scope, per the plan's own framing, is a proposal of its own: decide the entry keypath
(a new binding, or `v` with no selection), build the detail document into
`PagerSection`s with the existing typed specs attached as `AttachedTarget`s the way
`build_pager_document` already does for `CommitViewSpec`, hold the measured
open-to-first-paint budget the `ace` phase set (150 ms; sase-uk.8 measured ~140 ms for
the file document), and add PNG goldens under `tests/pager/visual/` for the
window-scoped label mode. Expect this to want an epic plan rather than a single pass.

task_type_fields.proposal: Render the ACE Agents-tab detail document itself as a SasePager document so its ~1,000 refs, paths, and URLs become pressable, which is what the window-scoped label mode sase-uk shipped dormant exists to make possible.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-uk's plan lists this under 'Out of scope for v1' and directs its land agent to record it as a follow-up: it changes a keypath the owner uses constantly and needs its own proposal and its own goldens.
